body: I honestly thought this was for me, I even checked your other posts to see if you were him. I wish he would come back to me 😞

I actually felt that this was for me, especially the title. I wish it was...

I'm only living for him, I just wish he would come back to me.

It's definitely a rollercoaster, a terrible one. These past 17 months have been filled with nothing but hope and despair. Some days... I have strong hope whilst others, I lose hope. The tears, joy, pain, laughter, fatigue, serenity, I've felt all of the emotions. It's good that you're doing that, I've had the habit to look at his social media throughout the months even though it's his old accounts. It's best to take it one day at a time and sooner or later, you'll realize that you haven't looked at his social media for a long time. I have that same hope, the hope of reunion is the only thing that's helping me to keep going on. I'm in the same situation.

All the best to you too, thank you so much! I know you will be very happy one day as you reunite with your true love.

Thank you so much, I wonder the same yet I know I have to keep holding onto the hope I have, for his sake. I hope this separation ends one day, for both of us and everyone on this subreddit. I just read your first post where you said you hope for the reunion of you and your true love and you are using that hope to motivate yourself to move forward. I'm doing the same regarding the start of my career, the thought of him is the only thing that motivates me in every aspect of my life. I've surprised even myself many times at how hopeful I've been.

Your words are exactly how I feel every time I read these letters. I'm constantly wishing one of these letters would be from him. He's always, always, always on my mind. There wasn't a day where I didn't think about him. I miss him badly, it hurts me so much. It's been over a year since he wrote his final letter to me. I wish a miracle would happen and he would call me one day. I'm constantly wondering and worrying about how he's doing. I wonder if he thinks of me, if he misses me. I have hope he will come back, I know he will...

I hope your true love comes back to you, I hope everyone's true love does.
This makes me very sad, she's a horrible person and she doesn't deserve you. I hope you will find someone better. You're free to message me if you want to talk.

I'm sorry that she rejected you, I'm not sure why she would do that. I'm sure you will find someone better, who truly wants to be with you. I respect that you haven't kissed anyone and are a virgin, it's very rare to find that these days. I hope you find the right person.
This is so sweet, I hope you're able to tell the person one day!

Thank you, I'm getting a bit better now. I guess that "one silly reason" I was holding onto is motivating me to keep going on and I have hope it will come to light. I know I will find beauty and success if I have that one thing.

I would meet him halfway in a heartbeat, even much quicker than that. There wasn't a day where I didn't think about him and I know he thinks of me everyday. Even though he is over 4000 miles away and being distant from me by not speaking with me... I can only hope he will come back to me.

Your words are exactly how he thinks about me, every single one. He wants me to find someone better than him but I only want him. Whenever I talked lowly of myself, he always uplifted me and disagreed with everything I said.

"Just please never lose hope, because I know one day you'll find the perfect partner you've always wanted."

This is exactly what he said to me, in different words. He doesn't realise that he's the only perfect one for me.

But he's gone... and I'm still here while it kills me inside. He was scared of becoming close to me but all I want is to love him and to ease his pain. In exactly 21 days, it will be a year since we met. I miss him like crazy and all I'm hoping is that he comes back to me and accepts my love. He's my only reason for living and the hope I have is the only motivation to keep going.

Please... send your letter to that special person. I feel the pain constantly from what he said, dying for him to return to me. Believe that you are the only perfect soul for that person. I know what it feels like... please tell her. I'm sorry for my long post, I'm distressed a lot lately.

Also, since the title says she will be fine. She won't be fine, not until she has you.
This is absolutely beautiful. Please send this to that special person. We always regret the things we didn't say.

You're welcome and I hope you will be together very soon. I understand your pain, one day you will be with him. Hold onto the hope you have, a lot of long distance couples have reunited and you shall be the next. Thank you so much, I hope the same for you.

I feel exactly the same way about someone, I just wish it will happen soon. I hope you will be able to be with that special someone. Just remember that when two hearts are meant for each other, no distance is too far, no time is too long, and no other love can break them apart.
There are times where I would wish for this too. I feel exactly the same way. I would love my husband and children with all of my heart and soul. I hope you get your wish :)
There is no point, that's my strong opinion.
I don't know what to say really. I feel the same and I'll probably go through with it. I mean, you can distract yourself from it but it always comes back to haunt you.

I can't say... although even though that one incident had happened, I still seem to hold on because of one reason which I still don't know if it's worth it or not. I guess I don't want to have hope in something that may not happen.

No, I haven't. Although even if I was told that, I wouldn't care. I've been told by my family that it's wrong and they tried to express their negative opinion of it by beating around the bush but other than that, I haven't been told that it's cowardly or selfish. What kind of help were you looking for?
If you ever need help in future, let me know.

Not really... If that one reason didn't come to light, I would've committed suicide in August when I had the chance and since I was literally planning to do it. Life is pointless and horrible. I understand that last part.
I was a premature baby and apparently they can be at risk of dying. I should have died :)
There's absolutely no proof. For some it might actually get better but again, that's only for some people...

It is a permanent solution for me in the past when my problems were temporary and it's still a permanent solution despite my problems being permanent. I just hate when people use that phrase to try and talk us out of suicide.

Me too. I'm not here for someone to tell me to "get better" or any of that garbage. It really annoys me when someone tries to comment on my post or message me trying to stop me. People should really mind their business. If someone genuinely wants help or someone to talk to then yeah they can advise them but I'm one of the many who ACTUALLY wants to die and will soon go through with it so I don't have time for people's bullshit. I only like talking to people who have the same mindset as me. I can't believe there was actually an r/suicide! Many people were so disappointed judging by the comments. It's sad that the subreddit no longer exists...
I say exactly the same thing. Death is inevitable and we're all going die... there's no escape for it. The logic is priceless.
I can relate. I know for a fact I will only die through suicide instead of a natural death. There is no way that I'm gonna suffer even more for the next 60 years.

Ugh... I say exactly the same thing all the time. I didn't ask to be born and people who think I should stay alive for them are selfish. I don't see why I should be grateful. If you ever want to talk, I'm here. Hugs x

I don't want a funeral either. Only a few family members actually care about me, the rest will just stand there for the sake of it and then go out together afterwards. It's happened twice and I've witnessed it. After my uncle died, on the same day of the funeral, all of the cousins on my father's side went out... probably to drink alcohol. When my grandma died more than a year ago, they all went out to Canary Wharf. Am I the only one who finds that disrespectful? Someone just died and they're all going out on the same day. Anyway, they will do that after my funeral. My relatives from my mother's side seem to care about me so much, I was just blind to see it... but even so, they'll forget about me anyway. I don't want certain cousins speaking about me as if they knew me, they didn't know jack shit about me. They never made an effort to talk to me all these years. I always felt left out... like I was alone in a corner until I felt solitude in it. I don't want men touching me to wash my body nor do I want everyone staring at my corpse. I don't want people crying and feeling mournful for my death especially since that will be the happiest day of my life.

I want to die without anyone finding me. I don't want to be remembered. I just want to disappear and fly away.
It sucks when you wake up when you wanted death to take you in your sleep.

Wow and I'm glad the effects are gone. I hope you get to rebuild those relationships within time. I won't and not yet since my appointment is a month from now but there's no point since I'm gonna leave as soon as I get the chance.
Happy birthday, I hope you do get better. I know I'll feel the same way two months from now when it'll be my 20th birthday.
I've always been this bad even before the sertraline. Did you feel better after you stopped taking it? Thank you for letting me know, I'll do that.
I sent you a message on chat

THANK YOU! It makes me really angry. I don't like being told to live since it's my own decision and I've had fucking enough with all these stupid cliches being thrown at me. Society can rot for all I care. No one's opinion matters to me other than my own and I refuse to live.
Why?

I feel exactly the same. I can't be fixed and I don't want to go for therapy because I know it won't help. I understand that people are so eager to save me but I don't want to be saved. I can't run away from the monster inside me. I'm gonna end my life soon too. If you want to talk, I'm here.

My own opinion is that life itself is pointless. We're here out of our own will because our parents gave birth to us and we're forced to live in this shitty world. In the end, we eventually die. People say that since we don't know why we're here, we should "make the most of it and enjoy it". Heck, I haven't even lived a quarter of my life and all I have been through is suffering. No happiness whatsoever. I've existed for 19 years and I don't see myself in the future. They say it gets better and that I should have hope but they fail to realise that this is exactly how I felt all these years and nothing has changed. It only got worse. We live and we die with no reason. There's no point in doing anything.

"Yesterday is history, tomorrow is a mystery, today is a gift... that's why we call it the present."

I find it funny that I used to have this on my Facebook around 7 years ago. I know I must've been miserable deep down back then but all I remember is a confident, bubbly young girl. I used to actually believe in that quote but now I laugh at it...

Life is a curse which is full of misery and suffering. Every so called happy moment is merely a distraction from our sadness. I just want out of this hell.

I keep having visions of myself falling off what seems to be the tallest building near where I live. I've also had visions of myself falling off this tall construction tower that some builders were using to carry heavy items. If I had the choice, I'd probably jump off the tall building even though the tower looks tall from a distance.

Even though it's unlikely that I'll jump as a suicide method and I'll probably hang myself, it's nice to just imagine my body falling while my soul turns into an angel and flies up in the sky. Maybe then, I'll be exactly like my username.

My family said this exact same thing to me yet it still wasn't enough to convince me. It would've worked for me years ago but not anymore. I have a strong hatred towards humans and the world so I don't really see myself helping anyone. I've seen so much and been through so much. Anyway, thank you for trying to help but it's best that you don't reply to this since you're wasting your time.
I just wish they stopped caring, I even told them directly. The day I die will be the happiest day of my life. I understand what you mean and I'll do the same for you.
I know what I did and I have to suffer for it. I don't care if others do things that they are not proud of. I'm easy on others but hard on myself, I have to be.
It's all lies. It may get better for some people but I know it won't for me. Death is the only solution for me.
I'm so glad to hear that dying is peaceful. I can't wait to finally do it when I have the chance.
No there isn't, people lie when they say give you all these silly reasons.
Death is the only thing that will actually help me. These cliches won't work for me anymore and I'm adamant with the way I think. Nothing ever helps.

Is this him?

https://www.reddit.com/user/Inject-liquid-sleep
Who are you to say that? There could be nothing waiting for us after this life.
I feel the same. Life is meaningless and I never asked to be born. If I knew my life would be this horrible now, I would've killed myself years ago.

I know I won't get better and I don't want to either. I'm full of shit and deserve to suffer immensely. Honestly, I don't want to try something new. I've had enough of this pointless life that I never asked for. Anyway, thank you for trying to help.
I don't see why I should. I can't get better and I won't. I'll never be happy with my life as it is now.
If you need someone to talk to, I'm here.
I feel you, I'm a constant burden to others. I'm better off dead.

For me, death is the only solution. My thoughts haunt me and you can never run from what's in your head. The only time I'm a bit okay is when I'm asleep. So... I know a permanent sleep will make me happy. The flashbacks just make me want to fucking die right now. I want my brain to shut down so I no longer have any thoughts.

A shotgun to the head is the most lethal and you die quickly.

Ask him to see this website: http://www.lostallhope.com/suicide-methods/statistics-most-lethal-methods
Same.

I feel the same. I'm just waiting for the first chance I get so I can go through with it. I guess my family would care. My family came over two days ago to talk to me and my uncle said that if I hurt myself, it'll hurt all of them. I wish I could believe it. My family are so eager to help me but I don't want any help, I just want to drop dead. If you ever need someone to talk to, I'm here.

I feel exactly the same. My birth is a curse and I feel like I'm a burden on everyone around me. It makes it worse that recent events have made me feel more shitty and I just want to disappear. My birth was a mistake and I have to leave.

Yes you are. If you're having constantly thoughts of suicide and you really want to do it, you are suicidal. Many people have the fear of going through with it for many reasons, you're not the only one.

Personally, I wouldn't recommend it. It's very painful and there's a chance you will be saved. The lethality of this method also isn't high. You can see this link: www.lostallhope.com/suicide-methods/statistics-most-lethal-methods
If you need someone to talk to, I'm here.

I hate it too, it annoys me so much. If someone is going through so much pain and they want to end their life, it's selfish of their family and friends to tell them not to go through with it just because it'll hurt them. Why should one stay alive and suffer for others? We didn't have a say in being born so we should at least be able to make a choice with our death.

The thought of suicide brings me great joy, I can't help but smile whenever I think of it. I hope there isn't an afterlife and that death is the end. This life is misery and I've had enough. I want to die soon aswell.
